crossRefs.note: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”
For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
“How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul…
He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so it was well, then. Wasn’t this to know me?” says Yahweh.
“You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.
He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.
A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction…

translations.web: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
translations.bsb: because I rescued the poor who cried out and the fatherless who had no helper.
translations.kjv: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help
translations.asv: Because I delivered the poor that cried, The fatherless also, that had none to help him.
